scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The discovery club
scenes.caption: A new player praises Kabir’s building skills, then asks him to leave the game chat and keep their conversation secret. Meera says friendly language does not mean a person is entitled to private contact, photos or personal details.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: A problem to solve
scenes.caption: A boundary is a rule about what contact feels appropriate and safe. Children can stop a conversation without winning an argument. Threats, repeated insults or requests for secrets are reasons to get help, even when the other person seems familiar.
scenes.speech: A boundary is a rule about what contact feels appropriate and safe. Children can stop a conversation without winning an argument. Threats, repeated insults or requests for secrets are reasons to get help, even when the other person seems familiar.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Try the idea
scenes.caption: The teacher practises calm reporting with fictional cards. Keep the message and sender information for an adult, without reposting harmful material to classmates. An adult can help use block and report controls. Asking for help does not make the learner responsible for someone else’s behaviour.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose and explain
scenes.caption: The player asks for a private secret conversation. Kabir is uncomfortable and has not shared any personal information. Compare the actions, then inspect the explanation before moving on.
scenes.speech: The player asks for a private secret conversation. Kabir is uncomfortable and has not shared any personal information. Compare the actions, then inspect the explanation before moving on.
scenes.dialogue: What is Kabir’s safest next step?

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: See the consequence
scenes.caption: Stop responding and tell a trusted adult, who can help preserve the message and use block or report controls. Kabir does not owe the player secrecy.
scenes.speech: Stop responding and tell a trusted adult, who can help preserve the message and use block or report controls. Kabir does not owe the player secrecy.
scenes.dialogue: Choose evidence without spreading harmful content.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Your turn in the lab
scenes.caption: Now open the practice lab. Work through contact boundaries, then useful evidence, then trusted help. Test each answer, read feedback and try again when needed. Save your evidence and explain one decision in your own words.
